name: Voltage divider 100 kΩ / 33 kΩ (battery sense)
description: Scales the 2S battery (up to 8.4 V) to 2.08 V for an ADC1 pin.
notes: 8.4 V x 33k/133k = 2.08 V, inside the ESP32 ADC's calibrated 150-2450 mV range at 11/12 dB attenuation (ESP32 datasheet, ESP-IDF ADC docs). It draws 63 uA from the battery. Mass and size are for two resistors (estimate).
